Planning Center Sync 0.9.0: Settings, Tags, Rooms and the event box redesigned

- Settings is split into panels (connection, what shows, descriptions, graphics, updates) with a line under each choice saying what it does, and steps for getting the Planning Center values.
- Tags and Rooms show a summary, clearer rows, and a Save bar that stays in view.
- The box on the event edit screen has plainer wording, opens the text box only when you choose your own description, and says when choices are saved.
